title: A grounded performer turns his partner's absurdity into humor by giving the audience a baseline to read it against
body:
- A comedy duo pairs two performers with contrasting personalities, one grounded and serious, one absurd and impulsive.
- The straight performer's orderly reactions supply the baseline the audience reads the funny partner's behavior against.
- The humor emerges from the contrast between grounded reaction and absurd action, not from either performer alone.
conversion: Absurdity becomes humor when a grounded partner supplies the baseline the audience reads it against.
